UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Stores user account information, excluding authentication credentials.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user account.

registrationDate.description: Date and time when the user registered.

SmokingHabit.title: SmokingHabit
SmokingHabit.description: Stores information about the user's smoking habits before and during the quitting process.

id.description: Unique identifier for the smoking habit entry.

cigarettesPerDay.description: Number of cigarettes smoked per day.

costPerPack.description: Cost of one pack of cigarettes.

currency.description: Currency used for the cost per pack (e.g., USD, EUR).

startDate.description: Date when the user started tracking their smoking habits.

UrgeEntry.title: UrgeEntry
UrgeEntry.description: Stores individual entries of smoking urges experienced by the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the urge entry.

timestamp.description: Date and time when the urge was experienced.

location.description: Location where the urge was experienced.

trigger.description: Description of the trigger that caused the urge.

intensity.description: Intensity of the urge on a scale (e.g., 1-10).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Stores individual chat messages exchanged between the user and the AI Carr chatbot.

id.description: Unique identifier for the chat message.

timestamp.description: Date and time when the message was sent.

sender.description: Indicates who sent the message ('user' or 'chatbot').

DailyTask.title: DailyTask
DailyTask.description: Stores daily tasks assigned to the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the daily task.

taskText.description: Text of the daily task (e.g., an insight from Allen Carr's book).

dueDate.description: Date when the task is due.

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the task has been completed.

InspirationalContent.title: InspirationalContent
InspirationalContent.description: Stores inspirational content for the user.

contentType.description: The type of content, example: Motivational Quote, Success Story, Excerpt.

publishDate.description: Date when the content was published.

firestore.reasoning: This Firestore structure prioritizes authorization independence and efficient data retrieval for the 'Easy Way Out' application. User-specific data (smoking habits, urge entries, chat messages, and daily tasks) are stored under user-specific paths, ensuring only the authenticated user can access their data. Inspirational content is stored in a separate collection with public read access.  Denormalization isn't strictly required here as path-based ownership `/users/{userId}/*` provides authorization independence. This approach eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules and supports atomic operations. The structure supports the QAPs by segregating user data and inspirational content, enabling secure list operations for each.
